title: SmartChunk Retrieval: Query-Aware Chunk Compression with Planning for Efficient Document RAG
authors: Xuechen Zhang; Koustava Goswami; Samet Oymak; Jiasi Chen; Nedim Lipka
why_relevant: Proposes adaptive chunking to reduce noisy/misleading retrieved chunks in long-document RAG, tangentially touching noisy retrieval robustness.
why_not_or_caveat: Primary focus is efficiency and accuracy of chunking, not robustness under unreliable evidence per se; no direct study of noise, conflict, attacks, or calibration.
